title: Book Three · Chapter 192: The Places Are Confirmed
story:
Two weeks after the early-April replies, Ronan and Anna have confirmations from both places.

Their signed answers arrived before the May deadlines. The coastal centre has kept Ronan's place. The design school has kept Anna's.

Ronan reads the arrival information at the table. His programme begins on the last Monday in July. The room can be used from the day before.

He must report that Sunday afternoon. The first class and room payment is due at the office before Monday's lessons.

Anna's course begins on the second Monday in July. She has her own arrival day on the sheet.

“I go first,” she says.

Ronan nods and writes the dates beside his route questions.

“We need to check the buses again nearer July.”

“And the last local bus after you arrive.”

He adds that question too.

They have bought no tickets yet. The route and room papers go into their separate folders.

That evening, Ronan writes his twenty-fifth letter to Leo. He gives the real news about both confirmed places and the different cities.

He asks how the three months of shop work went. Then he adds ordinary news: the larger gift box, the third wood sample, and Mum's jacket.

The next morning, he posts the letter from his separate spending money. The study envelopes stay at home.

When he returns, Mum is measuring a customer's sleeve. He waits until she has finished before he shows her the July date.

She reads it and puts a light mark in the household book.

Dad looks at it after work.

“A Sunday arrival.”

“And Monday lessons.”

He nods. Then he asks about the room office and the payment. Ronan shows him the exact line.

After dinner, they look at the blanket and sheets Ronan plans to take. Mum checks the corners while Dad finds a clean cloth for the shelf below them.

“Not packing today,” she says. “Just knowing what is here.”

Ronan smiles and folds the blanket back into its place.

Later, he meets Anna for a short walk. She has put her original drawings away safely and kept the new arrival sheet near her bed.

“It feels closer,” she says.

“Yes.”

He takes her hand. They walk past the closed library and stop beneath the lamp at the corner.

She leans toward him, and he kisses her gently. When they part, she rests her forehead against his for a moment before they take their own roads home.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

confirmation＝确认回复；report＝到场报到；arrival information＝到达报到说明；forehead＝额头。

## 理解问题

1. 两份确认回函是否在截止日前到达？两人的开课与报到安排怎样不同？
2. 有了名额确认是否等于已经买票或付课费？第二十五封信已寄了吗？

## 读句子

**The room can be used from the day before.**

拆开看：The room / can be used / from the day before.

宿舍房间／可以入住使用／从开课前一天开始。
